decisions.reason: Changing the NFT token standard and secondary-market royalty controls does not alter the reader's display mode, technology, or entry points.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording ERC-721C, whitelisted marketplaces, and marketplace-based royalty enforcement; the existing $10 royalty value remains unchanged.
The FAQ already states the $10 secondary-sale royalty, and the source does not require exposing the ERC-721C implementation or marketplace whitelist in FAQ content.
The token-standard confirmation does not necessarily change the About page's current descriptive, technology, or mechanics copy.
ERC-721C royalty enforcement does not change the trigger, recipient selection, or reward components for no-referral primary mints.
The gated-viewer metadata link remains valid unchanged; ERC-721C marketplace controls do not necessarily alter asset metadata rendering.
The token-standard and secondary-marketplace decision does not alter fiat wallet provisioning, held assets, confirmations, or reward access.
The source does not change any landing-page hero copy, layout, call to action, or selling-point emphasis.
Using ERC-721C does not change badge selection, milestones, storage semantics, or current badge effects.
Secondary-market royalty controls have no effect on the landing-page cover's location, sizing, cropping, overlap, or visibility rules.
The ERC-721C decision does not change ticket issuance, eligibility, expiration, reset, transfer, or secondary-sale ticket rules.
The source concerns secondary-market royalty enforcement and does not change the established $15 primary-mint allocation.
